# 🔷 1️⃣ Brain signature responses increase with object repetition

```{r}
# ============================================================
# LMM  — signature response (signature_z_block)
# Fixed: object repetition (timesObjectPresented_block 1-3)
# Random: subject
# ============================================================

lmm_brain_top <- lmer(
  signature_z_block ~ timesObjectPresented_block +  (1 + timesObjectPresented_block | Rnum),
  data = Brain_Behavior_data,
  REML = TRUE
)

summary(lmm_brain_top)
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Marginal predictions
# ------------------------------------------------------------

pred_brain_top   <- ggpredict(lmm_brain_top, terms = "timesObjectPresented_block")



```



# 🔷 2️⃣ Brain signature predicts trial-wise behavioral measures after accounting for confounds

```{r lmm_repetition_duration_controlled}

# ============================================================
# LMM — Trial-wise behavioral measures 
# Behavioral measures: 
# (1) Composite scores: SMA (Spatial Memory Precision), NE (Navigation Efficiency);
# (2) Individual scores: PlE (Placement error), AR (Accuracy rate), PE (Path efficiency), AE (Angular error)
# Fixed: signature response, search duration, object repetition
# Random: subject intercept and slopes
# ============================================================

outcome_vars <- c("SMA_z", "NE_z", "z_AR", "z_AE", "z_PE", "z_PlE")
output_names <- c("SMA", "NE", "AR", "AE", "PE", "PlE")



# Store fitted models, marginal predictions, and signature effects.
lmm_brain_controlled <- list()
pred_brain_controlled <- list()
signature_results <- vector("list", length(outcome_vars))


for (i in seq_along(outcome_vars)) {

  dv <- outcome_vars[i]
  label <- output_names[i]


  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Fit the mixed-effects model
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  model_formula <- as.formula(sprintf(
    paste(
      "%s ~ signature_z + search_duration_z + timesObjectPresented +",
      "(1 + signature_z + search_duration_z + timesObjectPresented || Rnum)"
    ),
    dv
  ))

  lmm_brain <- lmerTest::lmer(
    formula = model_formula,
    data = Brain_Behavior_data,
    REML = TRUE
  )

  lmm_brain_controlled[[label]] <- lmm_brain

  cat("\n--- Outcome:", label, "---\n")
  print(summary(lmm_brain))


  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Marginal predictions
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  pred_brain <- ggpredict(
    lmm_brain,
    terms = "signature_z"
  )

  pred_brain_controlled[[label]] <- pred_brain

  pred_df <- data.frame(
    x = pred_brain$x,
    fit = pred_brain$predicted,
    lower = pred_brain$conf.low,
    upper = pred_brain$conf.high
  )
  
#  write.csv(
#    pred_df,
#    file = file.path(
#      out_dir,
#      sprintf(
#        "%s_brain_fixedEffect_repetition_duration_controlled.csv",
#        label
#      )
#    ),
#    row.names = FALSE
#  )


  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Extract the signature fixed effect
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  signature_coef <- summary(lmm_brain)$coefficients["signature_z", ]

  signature_results[[i]] <- data.frame(
    outcome = label,
    beta = unname(signature_coef["Estimate"]),
    se = unname(signature_coef["Std. Error"]),
    df = unname(signature_coef["df"]),
    t = unname(signature_coef["t value"]),
    p = unname(signature_coef["Pr(>|t|)"])
  )
}


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Summarize and export signature effects across outcomes
# ------------------------------------------------------------

signature_results <- do.call(rbind, signature_results)
rownames(signature_results) <- NULL

print(signature_results)


```


#  🔷 3️⃣ Uncontrolled prediction 

```{r lmm_uncontrolled}

lmm_brain_uncontrolled <- list()
signature_results_uncontrolled <- vector("list", length(outcome_vars))


for (i in seq_along(outcome_vars)) {

  dv <- outcome_vars[i]
  label <- output_names[i]


  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Fit the mixed-effects model
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  model_formula <- as.formula(sprintf(
    paste(
      "%s ~ signature_z  +",
      "(1 + signature_z || Rnum)"
    ),
    dv
  ))

  lmm_brain <- lmerTest::lmer(
    formula = model_formula,
    data = Brain_Behavior_data,
    REML = TRUE
  )

  lmm_brain_uncontrolled[[label]] <- lmm_brain


  

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Extract the signature fixed effect
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  signature_coef <- summary(lmm_brain)$coefficients["signature_z", ]

  signature_results_uncontrolled[[i]] <- data.frame(
    outcome = label,
    beta = unname(signature_coef["Estimate"]),
    se = unname(signature_coef["Std. Error"]),
    df = unname(signature_coef["df"]),
    t = unname(signature_coef["t value"]),
    p = unname(signature_coef["Pr(>|t|)"])
  )
}


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Summarize and export signature effects across outcomes
# ------------------------------------------------------------

signature_results_uncontrolled <- do.call(rbind, signature_results_uncontrolled)
rownames(signature_results_uncontrolled) <- NULL

print(signature_results_uncontrolled)
```
